notes.title: Initial release! Now what is to come?
notes.notes:
First off what a journey it's been to get to this point! Thank you to all our contributors on the discord channel and our lovely testers for your time patience and love!

A couple of early folks are already asking questions and over the next few weeks this is our game plan:

1) Answer as many questions raised in the discussion forum or in discord and address any initial concerns in the game.

2) We are working on the next update which involves Mercenaries! Hired hands to help round out your deck and give you more flexibility. Look out for them in their own shops scattered throughout Port Haven.

Stay tuned for more announcements and meanwhile, enjoy the experience!
